description.value: The New Westminster Museum is a municipal history museum operated by the City of New Westminster, located on the third floor of 777 Columbia Street in the heart of the city's historic downtown. It explores the rich heritage of New Westminster, BC's first capital city on the mainland, through locally focused exhibits and archival collections. Entry is by donation, making it an accessible cultural stop for touring cyclists passing through the Fraser River corridor.
